fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.text-block.blk-txt since ld+json has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, Google News sitemap at /sitemap.xml) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleId.title: Article ID
articleId.description: Internal numeric The Citizen article ID, taken from the trailing digits of the article URL.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json node.

description.title: Description
description.description:
Short article teaser, from the NewsArticle ld+json node -- passed through verbatim including its HTML tags (e.g. "

...

").

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, reconstructed from

paragraphs inside div.text-block.blk-txt, with ad slots and the in-body "Related" teaser module excluded.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: "What you need to know" bullet box text, when present on the article (not all articles carry one) -- label stripped.

category.title: Category
category.description: Short category label from span.article-topic, e.g. "National", "Football".

categoryPath.title: Category path
categoryPath.description: Breadcrumb trail from the BreadcrumbList ld+json node with "Home" dropped, e.g. ["News", "National"].

author.title: Author
author.description: Raw author array from ld+json -- one or more Person objects with name/url. Unlike some sister NMG sites, The Citizen credits individual reporters here.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Raw publisher object from ld+json (name + logo).

image.title: Image
image.description: Raw array of lead image URLs from ld+json (landscape16x9 / landscape3x2 / portrait1x1 crops).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword string from the page's meta[name=keywords] tag.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Paywall flag from ld+json, present as the literal STRING "False" on articles the site marks as subscription-gated, absent (null) on free articles. Note: even when "False", this actor still recovers the full articleBody -- the gate is client-side only, not enforced on the raw HTTP response. See CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

hasPart.title: Has part
hasPart.description: Raw hasPart object from ld+json, present alongside isAccessibleForFree, naming the CSS selector (".text-block") the site's own paywall script targets.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the sitemap item.

section.title: Section
section.description: URL path segments between the domain and the trailing slug-id, e.g. "news/national", "sports/football" -- latest mode only, since the sitemap carries no explicit category field.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: ISO 8601 publish timestamp from the news:publication_date sitemap field -- latest mode only.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO language code from the news:language sitemap field -- latest mode only.

access.title: Access
access.description: Paywall flag from the news:access sitemap field -- "Subscription" when the site marks the article as gated, absent (null) on free articles -- latest mode only. Mirrors isAccessibleForFree on the article page.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
